d: A case of a woman being raped inside a police station has come to light in Jharkhand. The accusation is directed at a police officer posted at that very station. The woman had arrived at the police station seeking protection from her husband; however, it is alleged that instead of receiving help, she was subjected to a brutal assault. Following the incident, 15 police personnel, including the station in-charge, have been suspended. Three police officers, including a wireless operator, have been arrested. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) is now investigating the entire matter.
